hip-37279.x: Icy M-class moon orbiting a ringed gas giant in the Procyon (Alpha Canis Minoris) system; homeworld of the Andorians and founding Federation member.
Lush UNSC tourism and resort colony in the Procyon system besieged during Halo Wars (2531).
Procyon colony world settled by Crashlanders, swept by 1,500 km/h winds due to its extreme rotational tilt.
Eighth brightest star in the sky (11.5 ly), a yellow-white subgiant paired with faint white dwarf Procyon B.
hip-37279.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3

hip-65474.x: Massive artificial megastructure near Spica where the moonship Janus arrives across cosmic distances to encounter diverse interstellar civilizations.
Massive rotating ellipsoidal variable binary consisting of two B-type stars (250 ly) in a mutual 4-day orbit.
hip-65474.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3

trappist-1-b.x: Innermost rocky world of the ultra-compact TRAPPIST-1 resonant chain, receiving four times more stellar flux than Earth and confirmed by JWST MIRI to lack a thick atmosphere.

hip-27366.x: Luminous blue-white supergiant star marking the southeastern foot of Orion.
